communities to guide judges’ communication and understanding of issues as they arise.
The ETBB is an essential resource for each and every judicial office holder. The Judicial College
is proud to be able to publish this major revision providing, as it does, guidance to help each and
every one of you to achieve good communication and to demonstrate fairness in every court or
tribunal in which you may sit and which, together, will ensure that the interests of justice are
served in relation to every individual who comes before us.
Once again, with my thanks to the editorial committee.
Eleanor King
The Right Honourable Lady Justice King DBE, Chair of the Judicial College
